title: HOUNDSWORN joins the Games Library: 48 paid games, still $14.99
body:
HOUNDSWORN is in the CSAF Games Library from today. That makes 48 paid games on this page, still $14.99.

HOUNDSWORN is a top-down action adventure for Windows: 14 rooms of one old wood and three keepers to put down, the Great Boar, the Wolf Matriarch and the Stone Warden. You steer the ranger. Bracken, the beagle, is the second body. Send her at a beast and she pins it: a pinned beast cannot move or strike, and your blade lands twice as hard. Send her at nothing and she runs ahead and sits where she stops, on a pressure plate, through a gap in the roots, onto a lever you cannot reach. Call her back and she follows a scent and digs up what the wood has buried. She can be knocked down, and she gets up when you stand beside her. A first run takes about half an hour.

It has no page of its own yet, so for now this Library is the only place to get it. A page of its own, with a free browser demo of the Hollow Wood and the Great Boar, is planned.

If you own the Library: HOUNDSWORN is inside the "Action and adventure, part 2" download, which now holds 5 games (about 738 MB). Download part 2 again to get it. In every other download only the small Readme, catalogue and licence text files changed (they now list 48 games), so there is nothing else you need to download again.

Also new on the page: the cover and plates show the new count, HOUNDSWORN has a line under Latest additions, and its GIF is in the gallery until it has a page of its own.

If the Library gives you a good evening, a quick rating helps more than anything.
